definitions.gloss: looking away; looking to the side; being distracted
definitions.explanation: The act of looking away from what one should be paying attention to. Most commonly used in the context of driving, where it means taking one's eyes off the road.

examples.japanese: {脇見|わきみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{脇見|わきみ}⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。

⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}られて→取る：00565_toru⟧{脇見|わきみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していたら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わっていた→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: I was distracted by my phone and looking away, and the light had changed.

notes: Most frequently used in the compound {脇見|わきみ}⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧ (distracted driving / looking-away driving), which is a traffic violation in Japan. Common collocations: {脇見|わきみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to look away), {脇見|わきみ}⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧ (distracted driving), {脇見|わきみ}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ (accident caused by distracted driving). The ⟦{脇|わき}→脇：03790_waki⟧ here means 'side' or 'aside,' and ⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧ means 'looking.' Can also be used figuratively to mean being distracted from one's main task.
